n-nvidia-ceo-scandal.summary: Coins named for the Nvidia CEO story. The New York Times posted on X on 2026-11-08 at 20:10 UTC that Nvidia opened an investigation into its CEO Jensen Huang after he acknowledged to the board a relationship with a business executive whom U.S. intelligence determined to be a Chinese spy; an Axios post of the same evening links its report. Two coins are named The Nvidia Spy (Pump.fun and LaunchLab, symbol Alice), one Jensen Huang Coin and one Jensen Hung (Pump.fun). Dates from Codex: the Pump.fun Nvidia Spy pool opened on 2026-11-07 at 03:05 UTC, before the Times post; the LaunchLab one on 2026-11-08 at 20:19 UTC, nine minutes after it; Jensen Huang Coin on 2026-11-09 at 02:40 UTC and Jensen Hung at 04:12 UTC. A post says Nvidia found no evidence that company secrets were leaked; allegations are as reported in the posts and not verified here. None of the coins is shown to be connected to Nvidia, Jensen Huang or anyone in the story. Measured: four coins across all their pools.
